استهنت (form X)
# اِسْتَهَنْتُ (istahantu) /is.ta.han.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَهَانَ (istahāna)
# اِسْتَهَنْتَ (istahanta) /is.ta.han.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَهَانَ (istahāna)
# اِسْتَهَنْتِ (istahanti) /is.ta.han.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَهَانَ (istahāna)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
